en.title: Maximum Distinct Values in a Remainder Array
en.description:
For each position you may freely choose a non-negative secretKey, giving hash[i]=secretKey[i] mod param[i]. Find the maximum number of distinct values in the hash array.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..200000), and the second line contains n param values (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: remainders 0, 1, 2 can be chosen, 3 in total. Example 2: modulo 1 can only give 0, so there is 1 value. Example 3: there is only one position, so at most 1 value.
hints: Process the moduli in ascending order, having built 0..count−1 so far. If the modulus is greater than count, assign the new remainder count to the current position and increase the count.
